verdict.rationale: Portkey's AI gateway explicitly supports load balancing across multiple provider keys/models (docs-7), virtual keys mapping one Portkey key to many providers (docs-9, docs-41), configurable rate limits per hour/day/minute on requests or tokens (docs-38, docs-13), and automatic retries with exponential backoff or provider retry-after headers (docs-5, docs-6, docs-30) — directly addressing spreading traffic and throttling/queuing around rate limits. missing for 10: no explicit mention of a request queue mechanism (only retry/backoff), and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
